title: harper-nguyen-notes-to-self-2026-03-04
content:
Quick scratchpad - 2026-03-04

Morning TODO (prioritized)
- [ ] Follow up with SRE on canary metrics dashboard (latency p95, error rate) — need clear thresholds for rollback (ask: p95 > 350ms or error_rate > 0.5?).
- [ ] Fix flaky test in model-serving-harness (INF-432) — reproduces locally when sequence length > 1024. Suspect kv-cache race.
- [ ] Review PR #238 (runtime batching changes) — leave comments about batch cutoff heuristic.
- [ ] Prototype tiny prefix-caching experiment for chat workloads (start with redwood-owl-v1 small workload).
- [ ] Send calendar invite for rollout dry-run Thursday 3/5 10:30am

Meetings / notes
- 11:00 sync with Product (Maya, Jordan)
  - topics: canary thresholds, UI for per-route fallback, enable auto-fallback to quantized-variant when mem pressure high
  - agreed: pilot with 5% traffic, 10-minute evaluation windows, manual rollback for first two runs
  - action: Maya to add to product spec, Jordan to update rollout playbook (confluence)

Quick context / bits to capture
- Observed spike on staging yesterday after load test: KV cache evictions at t=12m, throughput drop ~20%
- Hypothesis: kv-cache indexing bug when switching model variant during active sessions
- TODO: add extra logging around kv-cache eviction reason (OOM vs ttl)

Local commands / reminders
- headless run: docker-compose -f docker/dev.yml up --build - use DEV_MODEL=redwood-owl-v1
- flush kv cache (dev): ./scripts/flush_kv.sh --model redwood-owl-v1 --env dev

Personal / errands
- Dentist appt to schedule: try to book next Tue morning (email: claire.dentist@example.com)
- Bring spare charger to office
- Order replacement keyboard (KBD-87) — check budget with ops (charge code: ENG-MISC)

Things done (today)
- [x] Triaged INF-427 latency alert, added follow-up todo for SRE
- [x] Wrote notes for canary roll checklist draft

Open questions / follow-ups
- Can we increase batch window by 20ms without violating p50 SLO? Need perf numbers from release-engineering.
- Is auto-fallback to quantized variant safe for generation tasks with structured outputs? Risk: truncated tokens or formatting differences. Need evals.

Random notes / fragments
- Try using prefix caching TTL=30s for chat to reduce repeated prompt costs
- Consider a canary metric that includes regression in semantic quality (eval set prompts) not just latency/errors

Links referenced
- Jira: INF-432 (flaky test)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/238
- Confluence: canary-rollout-guidelines

Notes to self: keep this doc lightweight — move final checklist into confluence when stable.
